notes: 2025-11-04 - Inbound from partner webinar. AE Samir assigned. Mid-market B2B analytics SaaS (multi-tenant).

Primary flows: in-app conversational assistant for customer success + contextual doc search across product docs and KBs. Secondary: summarization for case deflection; reranking to improve search precision.

Data residency stance: 'EU customer data must remain within EU for storage and primary inference processing' — legal asked for hard clause that prevents automatic failover to NA without opt-in. Customer also requires per-tenant data residency mapping.

Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logging with configurable retention tiers, KMS/customer-managed keys for Dedicated. SOC2 is table stakes; ISO27001 preferred. Ask from security team for access review workflow and periodic log exports.

Initial approach agreed: 1) Hosted API in EU region for quick integration and functional validation; 2) If cost/latency or scaling concerns, transition to Dedicated reserved pool (eu-west) with VPC peering and CMK. Optimize to recommend quantized model and batching settings.

Performance targets: p95 latency <120ms for short chat turns (<=128 tokens) for EU requests; peak throughput 80-120 rps for EU working hours; acceptable warm-state tail <200ms. Cross-region fallback must be visible/flagged in logs.

Cost sensitivity: moderate. Customer will consider 12-24 month commitment if Dedicated reduces per-token infra cost by ~30% vs Hosted. Wants Redwood Optimize to propose model size/quantization vs quality tradeoff matrix.

Multi-region routing notes: prefer strict EU-primary routing. Can accept NA fallback only for non-PII synthetic traffic or after explicit legal approval per tenant. Concern about latency vs residency: eu->na adds ~40-70ms depending on route; operations wants SLA on failover window.
- 2026-02-05: product demo (hosted API) — showcased streaming, function-calling, embeddings; dev team liked SDK ergonomics and streaming behavior.
- 2026-02-20: Hosted API POC (EU region) started — integrated SDK into staging, synthetic load tests performed; observed p95 ~110ms at 40 rps with prefix caching enabled.
- 2026-03-08: stress test with 3 concurrent worker nodes — throughput increased to 90 rps; p95 climbed to ~170ms for payloads >256 tokens. SE recommended Dedicated + optimized batching.
Security review: questionnaire v1 submitted 2026-02-25. Follow-up items: KMS key rotation policy, full schema for audit logs, proof of data residency controls for Hosted API EU region.
Customer quotes/notes: 'We love the fast time-to-value from Hosted API but can't gamble EU regulations. Dedicated looks promising if you can offer CMKs and an explicit residency guarantee.'
Open items: finalize Dedicated pricing proposal, include data residency legal language, define latency SLA for EU-only routing, confirm support for per-tenant residency mapping.
Next actions: SE Marta to produce Dedicated cost model by 2026-03-18; Legal to propose residency clause draft; schedule 2-week canary POC in eu-west-1 for late March.
